First Class seat
The luxury of space. This was one of the chief considera-
tions when we redesigned this First Class section. Your
new seat is wider, reclines farther, and provides more leg
and shin room. We added an inflatable lumbar support
device that shapes to the contour of your back, and
widened the armrest between seats. We even installed
fewer seats, to give you more room between rows. And
fewer seats means more hostess attention. Colors can do
a lot to lift a traveler's spirits. Our new interiors include
24 different color combinations with motifs based on the
great cities of the world which we serve.

millsfield:images_texts:
JUST
LOK
AROUND!
The airplane you are on is unique.
While many airlines have Boeing 707's,
this one has been totally refurbished and has
many completely new features to give you
the most pleasurable ride in the air.
This aircraft was specially designed for
the long-distance domestic routes of TWA's
exclusive Ambassador Service* But we also
fly it on shorter routes, many times a day,
which means you can often enjoy it even if
you're not on an Ambassador Service flight.
Note: The back cover of this piece is also a "Seat Occupied" card
Please feel free to use it if you have to leave your seat.
*Service mark owned exclusively by Trans World Airlines, Inc.

PLACE CARD
If you wish to retain this seat when you leave the airplane temporarily at
an intermediate stop, kindly place this side up on the cushion of your seat.
